attributes.action: Introduce statutory regulation and licensing for funeral homes and mortuaries.
attributes.additional_details:
Unlike Scotland, anyone in England & Wales can run a funeral home or mortuary without a license or inspection. Voluntary codes fail to protect grieving families and dignified care.

​We call for primary legislation enforcing:

​Statutory Standards: 
Legally binding rules on mortuary temperature, security & body tracking. ​
Price Transparency: Mandatory itemized pricing & owner disclosures.
Independent Regulator: 
A statutory body to license, inspect, fine & close non-compliant facilities.
attributes.background: Introduce primary legislation to establish a statutory licensing, regulatory, and inspection framework for all funeral directors and mortuary facilities in England and Wales.
